_comment: SCPI command PLACEHOLDERS ONLY. No instrument-specific commands have been invented. Replace every 'PLACEHOLDER_...' command string with the exact command from your VNA's programming manual before connecting to real hardware. See docs/SCPI_REPLACEMENT_GUIDE.md.

GENERIC_PLACEHOLDER.description: Placeholder profile. Not tied to any real instrument. Replace all command strings before connecting to hardware.

data_format.notes: Document whether the instrument returns comma-separated real/imag pairs (ASCII) or an IEEE-488.2 definite-length binary block, and whether byte order is big-endian or little-endian. Update the parsing logic in src/drivers/vna.py accordingly.

GENERIC_PLACEHOLDER.notes: Fill in manufacturer, model, GPIB address default, and command set from the instrument's SCPI/programming manual. Do not guess commands.

KEYSIGHT_PNA_X_N5242B.description: Standard Keysight PNA Series SCPI command set. Creates/selects measurements named 'MeasS11'/'MeasS21' on the active channel and forces ASCII data transfer so this application's existing ASCII parser works unchanged.

data_format.notes: select_channel forces 'FORM:DATA ASCII,0' so CALC:DATA?/CALC:X? return comma-separated ASCII instead of the PNA's default IEEE-488.2 binary block. create_measurement_s11/s21 define MeasS11/MeasS21 with CALC:PAR:DEF:EXT once per configure() call. Confirmed on real hardware (MY48220566, firmware A.16.20.04): if MeasS11/MeasS21 already exist from a previous configure() in the same instrument session, this raises SCPI error +104 'Duplicate measurement name' -- this is HARMLESS and expected on repeat configure() calls; the existing measurement is unaffected and select_measurement_s11/s21 (CALC:PAR:SEL, used on every S-parameter fetch) still selects it correctly. Also confirmed on this hardware: *OPC? returns '+1' (with an explicit sign), not bare '1' -- src/drivers/vna.py strips a leading '+' before comparing. Also confirmed: triggering a sweep on a channel with no measurement ever defined on it does not report completion via *OPC? at all (hangs indefinitely with no SCPI error) -- this is why measurement creation happens in configure(), before any sweep is ever triggered.

KEYSIGHT_PNA_X_N5242B.current_polarity_convention: Not applicable -- this is the VNA profile.
KEYSIGHT_PNA_X_N5242B.notes: trigger_single_sweep uses the real, standard SENS:SWE:MODE SINGle; query_sweep_complete uses *OPC?, which blocks until the triggered sweep actually finishes and then returns 1 -- set the GPIB/VISA timeout comfortably longer than one sweep's duration (IFBW, points, and averaging all affect this). set_trigger_mode is hard-coded to 'TRIG:SOUR IMMEDIATE' regardless of the GUI's trigger-mode selection, confirmed against real hardware (MY48220566, firmware A.16.20.04): sending the GUI's generic mode string verbatim (e.g. 'SINGLE') was rejected by the instrument with SCPI error -224 'Illegal parameter value', which silently left the trigger source on its previous value and caused SENS:SWE:MODE SING to hang waiting for a trigger that never arrived. Since this application always explicitly triggers each sweep itself over GPIB, IMMEDIATE (internal/free-run) is the only trigger source this workflow needs -- the GUI's Trigger Mode dropdown has no effect on this instrument's actual behavior. Verify every other command here against the N5242B's own SCPI Command Reference (Help menu on the instrument, or Keysight's PNA Series Programming Guide online) before an unattended run -- PNA-X firmware revisions vary slightly in the measurement-creation command set (legacy CALC:PAR vs newer CALC:MEAS interface).
